subject: Clarifying hosting route & evidence needs for Clearway PHI pilot
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@clearwayhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Clarifying hosting route & evidence needs for Clearway PHI pilot

Hi Samantha — great to meet today. Quick recap from our discovery and the asks we surfaced on the call, so we can align on next steps:

Use case summary:
- Ingesting and classifying PHI documents for clinical triage (PDF/text).
- Low-latency inference for near-real-time suggestions (~200 reqs/min average, spikes up to 1k reqs/min).

Hosting options we discussed (high level):
- Hosted API: fastest to go-live, but not appropriate for PHI without a signed BAA and additional controls; limited isolation compared to Dedicated/Private.
- Dedicated capacity: reserved GPU pools, predictable throughput and stronger tenancy isolation; supports audit logging and can be paired with our BAA.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): customer-managed network and KMS, full audit controls and evidence for audits—recommended for the most stringent audit requirements but longer lead time.

Immediate evidence we can provide: BAA template, SOC2 Type II attestation summary, and a redacted penetration test summary (we include a compressed set of artifacts below). Please confirm which of these you need first for procurement/legal to start review.

Questions for you (to size the recommendation):
1) Must the data remain US-resident?
2) Do you require customer-managed KMS (CMK) for keys?
3) Is exporting logs to your SIEM (S3 + syslog) required for the audit?
4) Any expected go-live date or procurement window (PO timing)?

Proposed next steps:
1) If you confirm Dedicated as preferred, we’ll prepare a scoped quote + mutual action plan and surface SLA/pen test evidence (target by 7/21).
2) If Private is required, we’ll follow up with an estimated provisioning timeline and a checklist of infra runbooks (target by 7/25).
3) Sign BAA to unblock PHI testing (we can provide the BAA template).

Attachments: Redwood_HIPAA_onepager.pdf (summary), SOC2_summary.txt (short attestation summary).

Happy to set a short follow-up call to walk the MAP once you’ve had a chance to review.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123

From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@clearwayhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Procure Team <procure@clearwayhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 15:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarifying hosting route & evidence needs for Clearway PHI pilot

Thanks Marissa — helpful recap. A few quick answers and asks: 

- We do require a signed BAA before any PHI is processed.
- SOC2 Type II attestation (full report or redacted PDF) + a summary of the most recent pentest results are required for our InfoSec intake.
- Data residency: US-only. Can you confirm your hosted/Dedicated regions are US-only for this account?
- We are leaning toward Dedicated at this stage because of predictability and ease of integration, but we need confirmation on: 
  * Whether Dedicated supports customer-managed KMS or if that is only available with Private/VPC.
  * If logs (access + audit) can be forwarded to our SIEM (secure S3 delivery + syslog connector).

Procure has asked for an initial estimate of monthly committed cost for Dedicated (baseline for planning). I’ll attach a quick throughput estimate from our infra team so you can better size GPUs.

Would appreciate a follow-up that covers: BAA + SOC2 deliverables, KMS options, log export options, and a rough provisioning timeline for Dedicated.

Samantha Ortiz
Director, Platform Ops — Clearway Health
samantha.ortiz@clearwayhealth.com

Marissa — forwarding my quick notes after reading Samantha’s reply. Key points for the Commercial + Security docs: 

1) Evidence set we can provide immediately:
   - SOC2 Type II (Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf) — we can provide a redacted copy for procurement.
   - Redacted pen-test summary (PenTest_redacted.txt).
   - BAA template (Redwood_BAA_template.docx) for Legal to start reviewing.

2) KMS & residency:
   - Private (VPC/on-prem) supports customer-managed KMS in all supported regions.
   - Dedicated can support customer KMS in select regions via KMS integration (need to confirm for the specific US region Clearway needs).
   - We can guarantee US-only tenancy for Dedicated in an account-specific configuration; will require paperwork in provisioning.

3) Provisioning timelines (rough):
   - Dedicated: 10-21 business days after PO and account onboarding (can be faster if we reuse existing reserved pools).
   - Private (VPC): 6-10 weeks for VPC setup + onboarding; on-prem longer (dependent on customer infra).

4) Pricing considerations: Dedicated has a material uplift vs Hosted (committed capacity pricing) — we need the throughput estimate Samantha mentioned to produce a scoped number.

Ask: Naomi — can you pull the redacted SOC2 PDF and pen-test summary and upload them to the MAP draft? Also can you draft a one-page SLA + provisioning timeline we can share with Clearway?

MAP highlights:
- Sign BAA (target: 7/22) — BAA template attached for legal review.
- Deliver SOC2 + redacted pentest (target: 7/21) — attached Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf and PenTest_redacted.txt.
- Confirm hosting route: please confirm Dedicated preference by 7/23 so we can prepare the committed capacity quote.
- Provisioning window: Dedicated estimated 10-21 business days from PO; Private/VPC 6-10 weeks.
- Logs & SIEM: we can wire S3-based delivery of audit logs and a syslog connector; Karthik will confirm KMS options for your selected region.

Next actions (proposed):
1) Review attached MAP and confirm Dedicated preference and US-only residency requirement by 7/23.
2) Legal: review BAA template and flag redlines (we can accept DocuSign).
3) Scheduling: technical onboarding call — Wed 7/21 at 10:00 AM PT (I’ll send a calendar invite if that works).

Attachments: Mutual_Action_Plan_Clearway_v1.docx, Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf, Redwood_BAA_template.docx
